Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome browse {#browse}

Open published projects and versions in the browse app.

```text
apiome browse [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`open`](#browse-open).

## apiome browse open {#browse-open}

Open a tenant, project or version page of the browse app in a web browser.

The browse app's address is APIOME_BROWSE_URL, else url in the [browse] section of the config file, else derived from --base-url: an api. host becomes browse., and a local API maps to the browse dev server on port 3001.

Exit codes: 0 opened (or printed); 2 bad PATH, no browse address, or an unknown --browser; 1 the browser could not be launched (use --print-url).

```text
apiome browse open [OPTIONS] PATH
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TARGET` | text | yes | tenant, tenant/project, tenant/project/version, or a longer path such as 'tenant/project/compare?v1=2.0.0&amp;v2=2.1.0'. Start with / for a path from the browse root. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--print-url` | flag |  |  | Print the URL instead of opening it (works without a display). |
| `--browser` | text |  |  | Browser to use instead of the default (e.g. firefox, chrome, safari). |
